title: tehas refresh --pr N --json
description: What tehas refresh --pr N --json prints, version 1, on exit 0, 3 and 1: whether the refresh of one pull request was asked for, and why not. host/docs/tools-github.md says what each field means. Every object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too; a program that reads the object still accepts fields it does not know. test/refresh_test.sh checks that the command prints the samples beside this file, and test/json_contract_test.sh checks them against it.
